rows.note: Use 唔同 as the all-purpose way to say that two things or amounts are different.

example.english: The flavors of these two coffees are unlike each other.
example.traditional: 呢兩杯咖啡嘅味道唔同。
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 bui1 gaa3 fe1 ge3 mei6 dou6 m4 tung4

rows.note: Use 唔似 when stressing that two things do not resemble each other rather than merely differ.

example.english: The shapes of these two cups are unlike each other.
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 zek3 bui1 ge3 jing4 zong6 m4 ci5

rows.note: Use 唔等 for unequal shares, quantities, or contributions rather than general difference.

example.english: Their shares are unlike in size.
example.jyutping: mui5 jan4 fan1 dou2 ge3 cin2 m4 dang2
